[Hebrew] Hebr. Flavit, inflavit, afflavit: Item idem quod praecedens [Hebrew] ut [Hebrew] Cum cessasset & quievisset ab ebrietate vini, id est, cum sobrius factus esset, Esther. 2. 1. Ithpehal Chald. [Hebrew] Postquam inflata fuerit cutis mea, Jobi 19.26.

page.notes: Much of the Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee script is only partly legible in the scan; the Hebrew and Syriac words are rendered as [Hebrew] placeholders where I could not read them letter by letter. Faint ghost text from the reverse side shows through and is omitted. A small mark at the lower left (partly visible letters) is not transcribed.
